node.statement: Off-diagonal Ha inverse propagation: there are universal C_rect < infinity and e_rect > 0 such that, for every H-CB datum with e <= e_rect, if Ha^Q_{P,R} is bijective at level one and Ha^Q_{R,R} has level-one lower modulus at least 1/4, then every amplification of Ha^Q_{P,R} is bijective with inverse norm at most 1+C_rect*e.
